v.t: I commend unto you Phebe our sister, which is a servant of the church which is at Cenchrea:

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, called to be an apostle (Rom 1:1).

v.t: That ye receive her in the Lord, as becometh saints, and that ye assist her in whatsoever business she hath need of you: for she hath been a succourer of many, and of myself also.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, called to be an apostle (Rom 1:1).

v.t: Greet Priscilla and Aquila my helpers in Christ Jesus:

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, called to be an apostle (Rom 1:1).

v.t: Who have for my life laid down their own necks: unto whom not only I give thanks, but also all the churches of the Gentiles.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, called to be an apostle (Rom 1:1).

v.t: Likewise greet the church that is in their house. Salute my wellbeloved Epaenetus, who is the firstfruits of Achaia unto Christ.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, called to be an apostle (Rom 1:1).

v.t: Greet Mary, who bestowed much labour on us.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, called to be an apostle (Rom 1:1).

v.t: Salute Andronicus and Junia, my kinsmen, and my fellowprisoners, who are of note among the apostles, who also were in Christ before me.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, called to be an apostle (Rom 1:1).

v.t: Greet Amplias my beloved in the Lord.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, called to be an apostle (Rom 1:1).

v.t: Salute Urbane, our helper in Christ, and Stachys my beloved.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, called to be an apostle (Rom 1:1).

v.t: Salute Apelles approved in Christ. Salute them which are of Aristobulus’ household.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, called to be an apostle (Rom 1:1).

v.t: Salute Herodion my kinsman. Greet them that be of the household of Narcissus, which are in the Lord.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, called to be an apostle (Rom 1:1).

v.t: Salute Tryphena and Tryphosa, who labour in the Lord. Salute the beloved Persis, which laboured much in the Lord.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, called to be an apostle (Rom 1:1).

v.t: Salute Rufus chosen in the Lord, and his mother and mine.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, called to be an apostle (Rom 1:1).

v.t: Salute Asyncritus, Phlegon, Hermas, Patrobas, Hermes, and the brethren which are with them.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, called to be an apostle (Rom 1:1).

v.t: Salute Philologus, and Julia, Nereus, and his sister, and Olympas, and all the saints which are with them.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, called to be an apostle (Rom 1:1).

v.t: Salute one another with an holy kiss. The churches of Christ salute you.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, called to be an apostle (Rom 1:1).

v.t: Now I beseech you, brethren, mark them which cause divisions and offences contrary to the doctrine which ye have learned; and avoid them.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, called to be an apostle (Rom 1:1).

v.t: For they that are such serve not our Lord Jesus Christ, but their own belly; and by good words and fair speeches deceive the hearts of the simple.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, called to be an apostle (Rom 1:1).

v.t: For your obedience is come abroad unto all men. I am glad therefore on your behalf: but yet I would have you wise unto that which is good, and simple concerning evil.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, called to be an apostle (Rom 1:1).

v.t: And the God of peace shall bruise Satan under your feet shortly. The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you. Amen.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, called to be an apostle (Rom 1:1).

v.t: Timotheus my workfellow, and Lucius, and Jason, and Sosipater, my kinsmen, salute you.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, called to be an apostle (Rom 1:1).

v.t: I Tertius, who wrote this epistle, salute you in the Lord.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, called to be an apostle (Rom 1:1).

v.t: Gaius mine host, and of the whole church, saluteth you. Erastus the chamberlain of the city saluteth you, and Quartus a brother.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, called to be an apostle (Rom 1:1).

v.t: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, called to be an apostle (Rom 1:1).

v.t: Now to him that is of power to stablish you according to my gospel, and the preaching of Jesus Christ, according to the revelation of the mystery, which was kept secret since the world began,

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, called to be an apostle (Rom 1:1).

v.t: But now is made manifest, and by the scriptures of the prophets, according to the commandment of the everlasting God, made known to all nations for the obedience of faith:

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, called to be an apostle (Rom 1:1).

v.t: To God only wise, be glory through Jesus Christ for ever. Amen.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, called to be an apostle (Rom 1:1).
